metadata.title: Lens spaces that cannot be obtained by two integral surgeries
metadata.abstract: In this article, we demonstrate that there exists an infinite family of lens spaces L(p,q) that cannot be obtained from the 3-sphere by two integral surgeries. The first such lens space in our family is L(177,29).
